• Fixed application updates so Electron completes installation before Termco restarts.
• Added a clear What’s new section for application and plugin updates.
• Preserved multiline application notes and per-plugin change summaries in the update review.

Important for upgrades from 0.9.4 and 0.9.5:

Those versions can interrupt their own automatic restart. Download and install Termco 0.9.6 manually once from this release. In-app updates will work normally after that.
